subject: sleep chronotypes
caption: Being a wolf in a nine to five world isn't a character flaw. It's a scheduling problem.

beats.text: You're not lazy and you're not undisciplined. You're one of four chronotypes.
Up before the alarm, sharp by nine, completely useless by eight at night.
You follow the sun. Most of the working world is built for you.
Your best thinking happens when everyone else is asleep.
Light sleeper, alert mind, tired all day. The unlucky one.
Stop fighting your clock. Put the hard thing at your peak, not your morning.
Follow for the stuff nobody teaches you.
